prompt: Black learns to share the red truck
title: Share the Red Truck
irony: Black clutches the red truck to stay boss of the game, but a boss with no players has no game until he shares and the fun comes back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun lights the street as Black zooms his shiny red truck past Navy and Jade.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Black brags he is best driver and keeps every turn, Navy gasps wow, Jade shouts dare.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Navy asks for one pull, Black hugs the truck tight, Jade frowns, the game stalls silent.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: All chant red truck around the stalled truck while Black blocks the small driver seat.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black races solo to prove it, truck wedges under Yellow porch steps, Navy gift string snaps useless.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Silver trips on the curb, truck tips over, wheels spin fast, Black sits alone with no cheers.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: All chant red truck around the tipped truck while Black stares at his empty cheering curb.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lilac kneels on the street and hums how tight hands leave no room for friends.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lilac sets her kitchen timer for turns, Black breathes small and hands Navy the pull string.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: All sing red truck round the rolling truck while Lilac turns the last line to sharing.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Red truck chant fades, morning street glows again, Black and Navy pull together laughing.
